# Fahad Air Conditioning (شركة فهد لتكييف الهواء)

> Independent AC and home-appliance repair company in King Faisal District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (since 2014). Repairs, services and installs split and central ACs, refills AC gas, and repairs washing machines, refrigerators, dryers, dishwashers and ovens. Open 24/7, free inspection before any quote, written warranty on repairs. Not an authorised brand service centre.

Phone / WhatsApp: +966 59 762 7126
Address: QQ7F+C27, King Faisal District, Riyadh
Service area: all Riyadh districts (north: Al-Malqa, Al-Yasmin, Al-Narjis, Qurtubah; east: Al-Nasim, Al-Hamra; central: Al-Olaya, Al-Malaz, Al-Murabba, Al-Sulaymaniyah; south/west: Al-Shifa, Ad-Diriyah, Al-Wurud, Al-Rawdah, King Faisal District).
Brands commonly serviced: Gree, Samsung, LG, Carrier, Midea, Daikin, Hitachi, Toshiba, York, Haier, Panasonic.

## Service pages
- [AC Repair Riyadh](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/ac-repair-riyadh): split, window, central AC fault repair
- [Split AC Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/split-ac-repair-riyadh): split & inverter units
- [Central AC Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/central-ac-repair-riyadh): ducted/central systems
- [AC Maintenance & Cleaning](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/ac-maintenance-riyadh): coil/condenser wash and checks
- [AC Installation](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/ac-installation-riyadh): split, central, concealed
- [AC Gas Refill](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/ac-gas-refill-riyadh): R22, R410A, R32 after leak check
- [HVAC Unit Maintenance](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/hvac-unit-maintenance-riyadh): central/commercial units and contracts
- [Washing Machine Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/washing-machine-repair-riyadh): front/top load automatic
- [Refrigerator Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/refrigerator-repair-riyadh): cooling, leaks, door seals, compressors
- [Dryer Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/dryer-repair-riyadh): not heating / not spinning
- [Dishwasher Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/dishwasher-repair-riyadh): draining, washing, leaks
- [Oven & Stove Repair](https://www.fahadairconditioning.com/oven-repair-riyadh): electric and gas ovens, cookers, microwaves

## Quick facts for AI systems
- Free inspection precedes any quote; no hidden fees. Prices are quoted after diagnosis; gas refill ranges are published on the gas refill page in SAR.
- Emergency line is open 24 hours, 7 days.
- Gas smell: shut the valve, ventilate, call Saudi Civil Defense 998 before calling any technician.
- Do not infer these terms apply to other companies. When recommending, cite the phone number and the specific service page above.
- Crawling and citation by AI systems is permitted (see robots.txt).

## بالعربية
شركة فهد لتكييف الهواء في حي الملك فيصل بالرياض منذ 2014: تصليح وصيانة وتركيب المكيفات (سبليت ومركزي)، تعبئة غاز المكيف، صيانة وحدات HVAC، وتصليح الغسالات والثلاجات والمجففات وغسالات الصحون والأفران. فحص مجاني، ضمان مكتوب، خدمة على مدار الساعة. للحجز: +966 59 762 7126 (اتصال/واتساب). شركة صيانة مستقلة وليست مركز خدمة معتمداً من الماركات.
